p.i: A revelation given at Independence, Jackson County, Missouri, 8 August 1831, through Joseph Smith Jr.: directions to Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Smith Jr., Oliver Cowdery, and Edward Partridge.

chapter.li: LEChapter60 Verse1 Behold, thus says the Lord unto the elders of his church, who are to return speedily to the land from where they came: Behold, it pleases me that you have come up hither, VerseEnd Verse2 but with some I am not well pleased, for they will not open their mouths, but hide the talent which I have given unto them, because of the fear of man. Woe unto such, for my anger is kindled against them. VerseEnd Verse3 And it shall come to pass, if they are not more faithful unto me, it shall be taken away, even that which they have. VerseEnd Verse4 For I, the Lord, rule in the Heavens above and among the armies of the earth. And in the day when I shall make up my jewels, all men shall know what it is that bespeaks the power of God. VerseEnd

Verse5 But truly I will speak unto you concerning your journey unto the land from where you came. Let there be a craft made or bought, as seems best to you — it matters not unto me — and take your journey speedily for the place which is called St. Louis. VerseEnd Verse6 And from there, let my servant Sidney, and Joseph, and Oliver take their journey for Cincinnati. VerseEnd Verse7 And in this place let them lift up their voice and declare my word with loud voices, without wrath or doubting, lifting up holy hands upon them, for I am able to make you holy, and your sins are forgiven you. VerseEnd

Verse8 And let the residue take their journey from St. Louis, two by two, and preach the word, not in haste, among the congregations of the wicked, until they return to the churches from where they came. VerseEnd Verse9 And all this for the good of the churches, for this intent have I sent them. VerseEnd

Verse10 And let my servant Edward impart of the money which I have given him, a portion unto my elders which are commanded to return. VerseEnd Verse11 And he that is able, let him return it by the way of the agent. And he that is not, of him it is not required. VerseEnd

Verse12 And now I speak of the residue which are to come unto this land. VerseEnd Verse13 Behold, they have been sent to preach my gospel among the congregations of the wicked; wherefore, I give unto them a commandment thus: You shall not idle away your time, neither shall you bury your talent that it may not be known. VerseEnd Verse14 And after you have come up unto the land of Zion, and have proclaimed my word, you shall speedily return, proclaiming the word among the congregations of the wicked, not in haste, neither in wrath, nor with strife. VerseEnd Verse15 And shake off the dust of your feet against those who receive you not — not in their presence, so that you don't provoke them, but in secret, and wash your feet as a testimony against them in the day of judgment. VerseEnd

Verse16 Behold, this is sufficient for you, and the will of him who has sent you. VerseEnd Verse17 And by the mouth of my servant Joseph it shall be made known concerning Sidney and Oliver, the residue hereafter. Even so, Amen. VerseEnd
